source_evidence_scope: The upstream commit, blob IDs, byte counts and SHA-256 values below were supplied as fixed source evidence for this adaptation. This file records that evidence; it does not independently re-verify the upstream repository, its license or its bytes.

files.rights: First-party VKP source under AGPL-3.0-only. This public copy retains the original attribution and adds no upstream media, font, binary or model-weight distribution.
retained: original fixture IDs: talking-head-synthetic, slides-screen-synthetic, mixed-visual-synthetic
original fixture types: talking_video, slides_or_screen_video, mixed_visual_video
original expected-artifact target names and local-only privacy boundary
original Chinese card text as an explicit optional mode
changed: removed private task-local source-review discovery and environment fallback
removed Windows system-font search; default font is Pillow's bundled default, and the original Chinese cards are available only with an explicitly supplied local font
default audio is a first-party generated PCM tone via stdlib wave/math, not upstream reference audio
default cards are synthetic ASCII; optional explicit card font preserves the original Chinese card text
tone duration/frequency validated against small documented bounds before any output, probe or sample allocation; a duration that rounds to zero at 0.001 s precision is rejected
optional operator audio specification with path, expected SHA-256, provenance and use-rights statement validated before any write or render
honest manifest labels: no speech/ASR reference for tone, explicit media/timing/hash scope, expected artifacts marked as targets not proven outputs, false transcript/OCR/review/knowledge claims

ffconcat uses generated relative card basenames with -safe 1 instead of arbitrary absolute names
ffprobe argv uses options supported by the supplied build (no -nostdin), closes stdin with DEVNULL, and requests the local file protocol only
ffmpeg argv requests decoder, encoder, filter and filter-complex thread limits of 2; timeouts are bounded and media children run serially
refuses nonempty output roots instead of overwriting or cleaning them

files.rights: First-party VKP source under AGPL-3.0-only. This public copy retains the original attribution and reads only local, operator-declared or same-root bundle inputs.
retained: original parsing/row/hash functions and row fields timeline_index, start_seconds, end_seconds, role, path, exists, sha256, evidence_status
original source-media selection order: timeline video_key, then manifest media_path, source_media_path, video_path
original deduplication intent, reworked to keep repeated timeline context
original operator boundary: local only, no external vision, no upload
changed: top-level and nested shapes validated; missing, empty or malformed input no longer falsely succeeds
only genuinely malformed JSON/unreadable-text input is converted to an input error; PermissionError/EPERM and other runtime filesystem errors propagate and stop before later probes or writes
filesystem probes use explicit stat and ignore only not-found/not-a-directory cases, so access-denied is not silently treated as missing
empty references are blocked and never resolved to the bundle directory; directories are never hashed
relative frame references resolve against the bundle root, not the ambient working directory
resolved frame references must stay inside the resolved bundle root; traversal, absolute-outside, foreign-drive/UNC and symlink escapes are blocked before any read
same-root bundle-reported source media is discovered and hashed in the original selection order, with relative values resolved against the bundle root
outside-bundle bundle-reported source media remains unread/blocked; outside source media is read only through the explicit operator --source-media input

the fixed timeline.json/manifest.json bundle members are resolved, contained and required to be regular files before any byte read; outside-root links and non-regular members fail before open while an absent optional manifest remains allowed

same-root bundle-reported source media is discovered and hashed without an explicit flag, while outside-root media needs the explicit operator path; manifest metadata separates contained autodiscovery from explicit inside/outside authorization instead of claiming explicit-only reads
missing/blocked/directory statuses, counts and locations stay visible; incomplete exports return nonzero
case-sensitive distinct paths are preserved; repeated timeline occurrences keep primary fields and record all occurrences
removed the ffmpeg version probe; extractor provenance is reported as unknown/not_probed instead of fabricated

both output destinations are validated before any write; symlink destinations, resolved escapes, nonregular destinations and unrelated existing frame-manifest.json artifacts are refused while a legitimate owned refresh is allowed
a non-regular existing output destination is refused even when known_valid_existing is true, because parsing existing JSON is not regular-file proof
a pure build_frame_manifest result reports destination validation as not checked/deferred; only the writing path after successful checks reports validated_before_write
manifest.json is unchanged by default; explicit --register opt-in only, complete exports only
compute/validate before writes; no transaction, OS-sandbox or TOCTOU guarantee is claimed

files.rights: First-party VKP source under AGPL-3.0-only; held out of this public addition.
files.decision: Held out of this public addition. This generic acceptance harness mutates process environment and platform identity, installs import/audit guards and invokes pytest over executor/session tests plus an offline evidence guard plugin. The supplied public inventory contains tests/test_codex_vision_executor.py, tests/test_codex_vision_session.py and tests/evidence_offline_guard.py; those sources, their runtime behavior and the isolated guard lifecycle were not reviewed or admitted in this task. Existence in the inventory is not runtime proof. The runner is not needed by the public fixture tools and is neither distributed nor adapted here; no pytest suite of this runner is claimed to pass.

files.rights: First-party synthetic test source under AGPL-3.0-only.
files.notes: Stdlib unittest with in-memory fakes; no real media, process, socket, temporary file or directory fixture, and no whole-package import. Includes mocked EACCES/EPERM propagation and mocked output-destination cases; no real privilege, symlink or ACL probes. Synthetic roots are native absolute paths (POSIX or Windows) and Windows drive/UNC forms are exercised lexically; no Linux runtime run is claimed.

Small orchestration of the two same scripts and local FFmpeg; no sample media is committed. Report refs use documented bases and are re-resolved/re-hashed; the bundle manifest does not invent a schema.
Original README bytes are an exact prefix; only an LF-only append is added.
